# Quarto

## Deploy quarto documents

If you want to learn more about how to publish using quarto the official documentation that covers the different cases can be found [here](https://quarto.org/docs/publishing/). 

In this section we will cover the three ways that we use to deploy quarto documents:

- deploy using **quarto pub**

- deploy using **Github Actions**
